title: The First Step Down
description: Marda Scole will put a name on her board for anyone who goes down the stair and comes back up it. She is not paying for the going down.

go_down.title: Down the stair
go_down.objective: Go down into the Undervault, and come back up.
go_down.journal: The stove-keeper in the long tent keeps a board of names with a mark against each for every time they have come back. A name with no mark on it is somebody she is still waiting on. She would rather I were a mark.

came_back.title: Came back up
came_back.journal: One floor down and back out the same hole. Marda made the mark, said the number out loud the way she does, and put the chalk back on the ledge.
